item.title: Heatwaves led to record heat-related deaths in England
item.body: UK heatwaves led to a record high of more than 5,000 heat-related deaths in England. The UKHSA had previously warned that it was likely 2026 could see the highest number of heat-associated deaths on record.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🌡️ Heatwaves led to record heat-related deaths in England

UK heatwaves led to a record high of more than 5,000 heat-related deaths in England. The UKHSA had previously warned that it was likely 2026 could see the highest number of heat-associated deaths on record.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 24 November, 10:20
